headword: {満員御礼|まんいんおんれい}
gloss: sold out; full house (with thanks to the audience)

definitions.gloss: sold out; full house; standing room only (with thanks)
definitions.explanation: An announcement that a venue is completely full, expressing gratitude to attendees. Originally from sumo and kabuki, where a banner with this phrase is displayed when all seats are filled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{満員御礼|まんいんおんれい}だ。
examples.english: Today's match is a full house.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{満員御礼|まんいんおんれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完売|かんばい}→完売：18954_kanbai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The concert was sold out — every ticket was gone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大相撲|おおずもう}→大相撲：10113_oozumou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}→千秋楽：16501_senshuuraku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{満員御礼|まんいんおんれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{垂|た}れ{幕|まく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: On the final day of the sumo tournament, the 'full house' banner was hung.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Literally means "full house — with thanks" (⟦{満員|まんいん}→満員：07584_manin⟧ = full capacity; {御礼|おんれい} = thanks, gratitude). Originally from the world of ⟦{大相撲|おおずもう}→大相撲：10113_oozumou⟧ (grand sumo) and ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧ (kabuki theater), where a special banner is displayed when all seats are sold.

USAGE:
Now used broadly for any event, concert, or venue that has sold out. It carries a celebratory tone — the organizers are publicly thanking the audience for filling the venue.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満員御礼|まんいんおんれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{垂|た}れ{幕|まく} (full-house banner)
- {満員御礼|まんいんおんれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (a full-house announcement is made)
